import java.util.Scanner;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BigInteger MOD = new BigInteger("998244353");
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        long m = scanner.nextLong();
        long L = scanner.nextLong();
        long R = scanner.nextLong();

        long k = R - L + 1;

        if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
            BigInteger exponent = BigInteger.valueOf(n * m);
            BigInteger base = BigInteger.valueOf(k);
            System.out.println(base.modPow(exponent, MOD));
        } else {
            long eCount = R / 2 - (L - 1) / 2;
            long oCount = k - eCount;
            BigInteger E = BigInteger.valueOf(eCount);
            BigInteger O = BigInteger.valueOf(oCount);
            BigInteger exp = BigInteger.valueOf(n * m);
            BigInteger sum = E.add(O).modPow(exp, MOD);
            BigInteger diff = E.subtract(O).modPow(exp, MOD);
            BigInteger result = sum.add(diff).multiply(BigInteger.ONE.add(MOD)).divide(BigInteger.TWO).mod(MOD);
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }
}
